name: Magma
description: Open-source mobile core network platform by the Linux Foundation (originally Meta). Supports 4G/5G with orchestrator, access gateway, and federation gateway components.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Containerized access gateways deployed via docker-compose; Orchestrator built with orc8r/cloud/docker/build.py --all

eval_notes: Carrier-grade platform designed for real operator deployments. Unique federation gateway enables integration with existing MNO cores. Good for testing operator-grade scenarios but heavier than academic alternatives. Linux Foundation access network platform. Development container support. Good for access gateway and network orchestration evals.
